storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: On Friday, the Federal Aviation Administration implemented a nationwide ground stop, resulting in over 8,200 flight cancellations, which accounted for more than 31% of scheduled flights in the US. The ground stop lasted nearly five hours, marking the longest such event since September 11, 2001. Officials attributed the disruption to outdated air traffic communications equipment and confirmed there was no evidence of a cyber attack. Flights have since resumed as airspace reopened.
